text.p: HealthCor Holdings Inc said on Tuesday it acquired GSS "Gold Seal Services" and Guardian Medical Equipment.

GSS, which provides skilled nursing, home health aide and therapy services through four locations in Texas, generated approximately $3 million in 1995 revenues and $3.1 million for the nine months ended September 1996.
Guardian, which is based in Norman, Okla., is a home medical equipment provider with total revenues of approximately $300,000 in 1995 and $440,000 for the nine months ended September 1996.
HealthCor, down 1/4 at 9-1/2 in morning trading, provides comprehensive home health care services in the southwestern and central United States.
